summary: --- name: writing-skills description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment --- # Writing Skills ## Overview **Writing skills IS Test-Driven Development applied to process documentation.** **Personal skills live in your runtime's skills directory** You write test cases (pressure scenarios with subagents), watch them fail (baseline behavior), write the skill (documentation), watch tests pass (agents comply), and refactor (close loopholes). **Core principle:** If you didn't watch an agent fail without the skill, you don't know if the skill teaches the right thing.
